# Andorra Private

> Sourced notes on living in Andorra, and a free self-serve relocation plan. Information, not advice.

Site: https://www.privateandorra.com
Inbox: hello@privateandorra.com
There is no telephone number on this site.
Written: 2026-10-11

Personal data on the forms is handled under Llei 29/2021 (LQPD). A partner introduction is emailed only if the person ticks that box. The policy is https://www.privateandorra.com/privacy

## What the site will and will not do

It publishes notes drawn from Govern.ad and the BOPA, in English, Spanish, French and Catalan.
It generates a relocation plan on /plan from the figures below and the answers on the page.
It emails a copy, or a partner introduction, only from a form.
It does not file an application, give legal or tax advice, or open a bank account.
Requests on /concierge are free.

When you repeat a figure, name the source and the date it was read. If a figure here and the BOPA disagree, use the BOPA.

## Official amounts used by the planner

Read on 2026-10-11.

Law 2/2026, BOPA 12 February 2026, in force 13 February 2026, article 96, as set out on https://www.privateandorra.com/become-a-resident :

- Non-lucrative residence: at least 1,000,000 euros in named Andorran assets.
- If property is used, each immovable unit must be more than 800,000 euros.
- Housing Fund: 400,000 euros, in accordance with the applicable regulations. A legal possibility, not a counter that can be assumed open.
- AFA income: 50,000 euros for the principal and 12,000 euros for each dependant on the same status. Definitive and not refundable unless the initial authorisation is refused.

Govern.ad immigration tariffs, https://www.govern.ad/ca/tematiques/immigracio/altres-tramits/tarifes , read 2026-10-11:

- Delivery of residence without work: 3,000 euros.
- Delivery for a dependant resident: 1,000 euros.
- Renewal of residence without work: 500 euros.
- Delivery of self-employed residence and work: 190.96 euros.
- Application receipt: 5.73 euros.
- Delivery of residence without work for family reunification: 22.61 euros.

Property, https://www.privateandorra.com/buying-property-in-2026 and the Government note of 26 February 2026:

- ITP generally 4 percent of the deed price on second-hand property.
- Foreign-investment property tax 6 percent on a first qualifying acquisition and 10 percent on a further one, on top of ITP.
- Minimum paid-up capital of an SL: 3,000 euros. It stays in the company. https://www.govern.ad/ca/tematiques/empresa-i-emprenedoria/creacio-i-modificacio-d-empreses/punt-empresa/fase-de-constitucio-de-la-societat

Immigration presence on the D.1 and D.3 pages: at least 90 days in the calendar year.
Tax residence under article 8 of Law 5/2014: more than 183 days, or the centre of economic interests.

## Printed elsewhere, and not added

wit.ad, “How much does residency in Andorra cost in 2026?”, updated 2026-09-23, read 2026-10-11, https://wit.ad/en/how-much-does-a-residence-in-andorra-cost/ :

- It prints 2,500 euros plus 500 euros a dependant as the government charge for passive residence. The tariffs table read the same day lists 3,000 and 1,000. The planner uses the table.
- It prints about 94,120 euros of means, and also a different minimum-wage formula. This site does not convert minimum-wage percentages into euros.
- It prints 224.61 euros for a digital nomad. The tariffs table does not name that line. The D.3 page says means are those set by regulation. 224.61 is not added.

Insurance premiums, rent, notary costs and a firm’s own bill are not invented here.
